title: Devcontainer: pinned toolchain, agent hooks, and a workspace-scoped git wrapper
summary: This change turns the devcontainer image from a thin Rust + git-town box into a fully pinned factory environment. It adds moon, gh, actionlint, uv, Node 22, pnpm, Bun, four coding agents (codex, claude-code, opencode, omp), dsh, the NVIDIA skill linters, and the archify skills, each pinned by version and SHA-256 or commit. It builds the repo's own dsh/omp/opencode integrations from the pnpm lockfile and installs them as root-owned, read-only hook wiring for every agent. The system-wide core.hooksPath is replaced by a git wrapper that forces /opt/factory/githooks only for repositories under the workspace mount, and a battery of build-time tests now proves the wrapper, the hooks, the toolchain read-only-ness, and image cleanliness before the image ships.

nodes.label: Developer
nodes.summary: The person running the container; supplies GH_TOKEN through remoteEnv.

nodes.label: devcontainer.json
nodes.subtitle: workspaceMount + remoteEnv
nodes.summary: Now pins the bind mount to /workspace, forwards GH_TOKEN from the host environment, and checks osf, moon, node and pnpm in postCreateCommand.

nodes.label: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: The single largest file in the change. Adds every pinned tool download, the pnpm integration build, the agent hook wiring, and the build-time test invocations.

nodes.label: osf binary
nodes.subtitle: /opt/factory/bin/osf, mode 0555
nodes.summary: Built from crates/ and installed root-owned and read-only, exactly as before; the change only adds a cargo registry cache mount around the build.

nodes.label: pnpm integration build
nodes.subtitle: pnpm --filter dsh,omp,opencode run build
nodes.summary: A new build stage that installs the workspace from pnpm-lock.yaml and builds the three integration packages whose dist/ output the hook wiring copies into place.

nodes.label: Agent hook wiring
nodes.subtitle: /etc/codex, /etc/claude-code, /etc/opencode, ~/.dsh
nodes.summary: Root-owned, read-only hook files for every supported agent, produced by osf hooks install --agents and then locked down; dsh's two profiles get the plugin copied in under node_modules.

nodes.label: Build-time tests
nodes.subtitle: 9 scripts under .devcontainer/tests
nodes.summary: Each test runs during the image build and fails the build on regression: git wrapper refusals, git hooks, agent hooks, coding-agent tools, builder tools, dsh startup, skills installed, toolchain read-only, image clean.

nodes.label: git wrapper
nodes.subtitle: /opt/factory/bin/git
nodes.summary: Now decides whether the repository sits under OSF_WORKSPACE_ROOT before forcing core.hooksPath on the command line, so a scratch repo under /tmp is left alone. Still refuses --no-verify and -n on commit and --no-verify on push.

nodes.label: git hooks
nodes.subtitle: /opt/factory/githooks
nodes.summary: pre-commit, commit-msg and pre-push, each calling osf; unchanged in content, but now reached through the wrapper's forced hooks path rather than a system-wide config.

nodes.label: Coding agents
nodes.subtitle: codex, claude, opencode, omp, dsh
nodes.summary: Five agent CLIs installed into the image, each usable as a builder or reviewer; OSF_DEFAULT_BUILDER selects dsh.

nodes.label: osf hook
nodes.subtitle: prompt and stop events
nodes.summary: The command every agent's hook file invokes; it supports only the prompt and stop events, so no pre-tool-use hook is wired anywhere.

nodes.label: /workspace bind mount
nodes.subtitle: OSF_WORKSPACE_ROOT
nodes.summary: The one folder the wrapper treats as the workspace; devcontainer.json binds the repo here and the Dockerfile passes the same value to the wrapper as an environment variable.

nodes.label: Release hosts
nodes.subtitle: GitHub releases, nodejs.org
nodes.summary: moon, gh, actionlint, uv, Node, Bun and git-town are each fetched from their own release host and checked against a published SHA-256.

nodes.label: npm registry
nodes.subtitle: registry.npmjs.org
nodes.summary: The four coding agents, dsh, and the workspace's own dependencies all resolve here; the agents are pinned to exact versions, dsh to a lockfile.

nodes.label: NVIDIA skill repos
nodes.subtitle: skillspector, SkillEvaluator
nodes.summary: Installed through uv at pinned 40-character commits, per issue #196, so osf lint skill has both tools on PATH.

nodes.label: archify skills
nodes.subtitle: tt-a1i/archify @ pinned commit
nodes.summary: Two skills added through the skills CLI at a pinned commit, for opencode, codex and claude-code only, since the skills tool does not know dsh or omp.

edges.label: builds from
edges.summary: devcontainer.json names the Dockerfile and now also fixes the workspace mount and folder.

edges.label: pinned tarballs + SHA-256
edges.summary: Every new tool is downloaded from its own release host and verified against a published checksum before install.

edges.label: npm install -g, npm ci
edges.summary: The four agent CLIs install globally; dsh installs from its own lockfile under /opt/dsh.

edges.label: uv tool install @ commit
edges.summary: SkillSpector and SkillEvaluator are installed from git at pinned commits, with UV_TOOL_DIR and UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR moved out of root's home so dev can read them.

edges.label: skills add @ commit
edges.summary: The archify skills are added at a pinned commit for the three agents the skills tool knows.

edges.label: cargo build --release
edges.summary: Unchanged in substance; the build now runs behind a cargo registry cache mount.

edges.label: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
edges.summary: The integration packages are built from the same lockfile the rest of CI uses, so their dependency versions match.

edges.label: dist/ copied into place
edges.summary: The built dsh, omp and opencode plugin output is copied into the root-owned hook directories and the home node_modules, then the build tree is deleted.

edges.label: sh <test>.sh
edges.summary: Nine test scripts run during the build; a failure fails the image rather than shipping quietly.

edges.label: opens in container
edges.summary: The developer opens the repo in the container; GH_TOKEN is forwarded from the host environment.

edges.label: bind mount
edges.summary: The repository is bound at /workspace, the same path the wrapper reads from OSF_WORKSPACE_ROOT.

edges.label: -c core.hooksPath=/opt/factory/githooks
edges.summary: The wrapper forces the hooks path on the command line for repositories under the workspace, replacing the system-wide core.hooksPath the image used to set.

edges.label: OSF_WORKSPACE_ROOT
edges.summary: The wrapper reads this variable to decide whether the repository it is running in is the workspace or a scratch repo.

edges.label: osf <check>
edges.summary: Each hook still calls osf; the change is how the hooks are reached, not what they do.

edges.label: prompt / stop events
edges.summary: Every agent's hook file invokes osf hook for the one or two events osf hook supports.

edges.label: reads root-owned config
edges.summary: Each agent reads its own root-owned hook file, which dev cannot edit.

edges.label: edits files under /workspace
edges.summary: The agents work on the repository as mounted; the wrapper is what constrains their git calls.

flows.title: Image build: pinned tools, integrations, and hook wiring
flows.summary: What happens when the devcontainer image is built, from the first apt install to the last cleanliness test.

messages.label: apt-get install jq, xz-utils, unzip, bubblewrap
messages.note: bubblewrap is new and is what dsh's sandbox needs.

messages.label: moon, gh, actionlint, uv, Node, Bun, git-town
messages.note: Each download is checked against a published SHA-256 before install.

messages.label: npm install -g codex, claude-code, opencode-ai, omp
messages.note: Pinned to exact versions; write bits stripped afterwards.

messages.label: npm ci from .devcontainer/dsh/package-lock.json
messages.note: dsh 0.2.0-rc.2, installed under /opt/dsh and symlinked onto PATH.

messages.label: cargo build --release --bin osf
messages.note: Now behind a cargo registry cache mount; the installed binary is unchanged.

messages.label: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --filter dsh,omp,opencode run build
messages.note: Built from the repo's own lockfile so versions match what pnpm -r test proves.

messages.label: dist/ copied into root-owned hook dirs
messages.note: osf hooks install --agents writes the home copies; the system copies are the ones a changed HOME cannot move.

messages.label: sh <test>.sh
messages.note: Wrapper refusals, hooks, agent tools, dsh startup, skills, read-only toolchain, image cleanliness.

messages.label: image-clean.sh passes
messages.note: Proves no root cache or dsh session state reached a layer.

flows.title: A git commit inside the container
flows.summary: How a commit made by the developer or by a coding agent reaches the factory hooks, and how a scratch repository under /tmp is left alone.

messages.label: git commit
messages.note: The wrapper is first on PATH, so every git call goes through it.

messages.label: is this repo under OSF_WORKSPACE_ROOT?
messages.note: A scratch repo under /tmp is not, so it keeps its own hooks path.

messages.label: -c core.hooksPath=/opt/factory/githooks
messages.note: Forced on the command line rather than set system-wide, so it applies only where intended.

messages.label: refuse --no-verify / -n
messages.note: The refusal happens before the real git is called.

messages.label: osf <check>
messages.note: pre-commit, commit-msg and pre-push each call osf.

messages.label: pass or fail
messages.note: A failure stops the commit; the agent sees the osf output.
